Package hadur117.core.melee

Class TeamConcord

java.lang.Object
hadur117.core.melee.TeamConcord
final class TeamConcord extends Object
TMODE-33, the team brain after Ogi's design, written our own way: the parts of TeamModes.Mode.CONCORD that keep state across ticks.
  • Modes. The pack hunt and its range variants stand down; FINISH plays; GANG plays once this battle has shown ganging (gangOn()).
  • Gang watch. Every tick, each member in view (Hadur and its teammates) counts as one member-turn, ganged with MinimumRiskMovement.GANG_SIZE or more enemies within MinimumRiskMovement.GANG_RANGE. After GANG_TURNS member-turns, GANG plays while GANG_SHARE or more of them were ganged. A team that spreads out never turns it on; one that gangs up does within a round. Kept for the battle.
  • Radar groups. Each enemy belongs to the member nearest it, so the members split the field and each sweeps only its own group (group(java.awt.geom.Point2D.Double, java.util.List<java.awt.geom.Point2D.Double>, java.util.List<hadur117.core.world.EnemyInfo>)).

Team-only, like every mode: the controller reaches it only with a living teammate.
